description:
**This position is contingent upon contract award** 
 SOSi is seeking a Cloud Web Developers to support mission requirements for a structured approach to further develop, integrate, and sustain a scalable, federated data ecosystem that enhances interoperability, governance, and mission-driven analytics for a DoD customer. The primary objective of the program is to bridge the operational gaps between DoD, IC, interagency, and non-traditional international partners to enable real-time information sharing, dynamic data integration, and mission-tailored analytical capabilities.
 Design, develop, and maintain secure cloud-based web applications
 Ensure compliance with FedRAMP and DoD Impact Level (IL) security requirements
 Develop and maintain APIs within cloud-native architectures
 Work within Microsoft Azure and AWS environments
 Apply modern web frameworks and secure development best practices
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

 OR five (5) years of equivalent experience in cloud-based web development.
 Demonstrated experience developing secure web applications.
 Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React or Angular.
 Experience with API development using REST, GraphQL.
 Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure.
 Experience with serverless architecture and CI/CD pipelines.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 AWS Certified Developer – Associate
 Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate
 
 Work Environment 
 Offsite/remote.
 Fast paced, deadline-oriented environment.
 May require periods of non-traditional working hours including consecutive nights or weekends (if applicable).
 Working at SOSi 
 All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.
